subject: Media Literacy
title: Influencer Marketing
description: A micro-lesson that makes Influencer Marketing usable.

hook.text: A teenager promotes a skincare product to her 5 million followers. She's never used it. She was paid $50,000.

buildup.text: Influencer marketing pays social media personalities to promote products to their followers.

discovery.text: It works because followers trust influencers like friends — the recommendation feels personal, not commercial.

twist.text: Many influencers promote products they don't use, with minimal disclosure about the paid relationship.

climax.text: When a friend recommends a restaurant, that's trust. When an influencer does, it might be a transaction.

punchline.text: That 'honest review' might have a price tag you can't see.

quiz.question: Why is influencer marketing effective?
options: Influencers only promote products they love
Followers trust influencers like friends, making the ad feel personal
